mu_name_from: Icarus's object slot 9, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1128).
sheet_from: Data/Object11/, from MuMain, decoded under an ic_ prefix (Object11's).
material_note: Read off the art: pale frosted stone at the crown of the sheet fading to black at its foot.
why_this_one: A floating pillar, 4.5 m, white at the top fading black; 14 of them, mostly in the south half, a few tipped. Its 3-bone clip (24 keys) bobs bone 0 about 10 cm and bobs and turns about its axis on its clip: the only animated placements in Icarus. Objects batch 3 (the user, 2026-10-06: 'do next objects'). docs/icarus-port.md B §1.2.
play_speed_from: MoveObject's WD_10HEAVEN arm is empty (docs/icarus-port.md B §2), so its clip plays at the 0.16 every object starts with.
effects_note: No MoveObject or RenderObjectVisual arm: its clip is its whole effect. MU's height kept (decision 4).
